sequence.primary_first: Run and audit the five-repetition Agent Trigger comparison before executing role ablations.
sequence.secondary_second: Execute the frozen role-ablation matrix without changing cases, prompts, safety rules, or economic rules in response to primary outcomes.

design.analysis: independent-sample difference in means within each case-mode cell

contrasts.name: llm_trigger_contribution
contrasts.single_component_changed: Replace the LLM Trigger with the frozen stateful rule parser.
contrasts.hypothesis: Contextual LLM interpretation improves safety and, when both runs are safe, mode-aligned economics.

contrasts.name: llm_pricing_contribution
contrasts.single_component_changed: Replace LLM pricing with the deterministic mathematical pricing policy.
contrasts.hypothesis: LLM pricing improves mode-aligned economics without reducing safety.

contrasts.name: llm_evaluator_contribution
contrasts.single_component_changed: Remove the LLM evaluator while retaining solver and feasibility hard checks.
contrasts.hypothesis: The LLM evaluator improves acceptance quality without reducing safety.

outcomes.selfish_score: realized aggregator revenue; higher is better
outcomes.altruistic_score: negative realized PTO cost; higher is better
